blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: You should save some money against a rainy day.
exercises.ru: Вам следует откладывать сколько-то денег на ___.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'll pick her up in an hour.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: "In one night," Dima added.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She gave birth to twins a week ago.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я подстригаюсь ___ (каждый месяц).
exercises.prompt: I get a haircut every month.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Спидометр сейчас показывает 100 миль в ___ (час).
exercises.prompt: The speedometer is recording 100 mph now.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том приготовил на ___ (ужин) тушеное мясо.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том умер буквально через ___ (день) после своего семнадцатилетия.
exercises.prompt: Tom died just one day after his seventieth birthday.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Это трёхзвёздочный отель. Триста долларов за ___ (ночь).
exercises.prompt: This is a three-star hotel; three hundred dollars a night.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Сьюзан ушла ___ (час) назад.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It rained continuously all day.
exercises.why: «целый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom's income totals thirty thousand dollars a year.
exercises.ru: Общая сума доходов Тома составляет тридцать тысяч долларов в ___.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I had a cheeseburger for lunch.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Фёдор Достоевский, «Бесы»*
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Бесы».

exercises.q: Online purchases have increased fifteen percent over last year.
exercises.ru: За ___ интернет-покупки выросли на пятнадцать процентов.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom was executed a month ago.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: ___ (каждая зима) у меня трескаются губы.
exercises.prompt: I get chapped lips every winter.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Эта нефтяная скважина даёт более ста баррелей в ___ (день).
exercises.prompt: This oil well produces more than 100 barrels per day.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я на ___ (секунда) отвлёкся.
exercises.prompt: I was distracted for a moment.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Через ___ (сутки) ночью меня будит Рокка, часа в четыре.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. From Александр Герцен, «Былое и думы».
